transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Hi, yeah, nice to meet you too. Um, so the main reason I came in is just that I get pulled off track so easily. Like, I’ll be working on this dashboard I
Did you have trouble staying focused as a child?

Yeah, um, even back in elementary school I did. My teachers were always writing comments on my report cards about how I’d rush through my worksheets and just completely lose track of the directions. And they always said I talked over my classmates during group work. Actually, I remember this one group project in fourth grade where we had to build a California mission out of sugar cubes, and I was so obsessed with getting the sugar cubes perfectly stacked—which is funny because I absolutely
Do these focus problems also cause trouble for you outside of work?

Yeah, definitely. It’s not just work... well, I mean, I'm a student right now, but I do freelance stuff on the side. And, um, it definitely causes issues there. I’ve actually lost a couple of small freelance contracts because people just couldn't rely on me to follow through cleanly. Like, I’d miss a detail or forget to send an update. And I even missed out on this huge portfolio competition recently because of it. The prize was this amazing tablet, which I totally need because my current one has this crack right down the middle—my cat knocked it off my desk last month. He’s orange and just so clumsy, you know? But anyway, it’s also made some friends and collaborators hesitant to work with me. They always say they love my ideas, but then when it comes to actually teaming up, they get kind of weird about it. Which sucks, because I love collaborating. I actually met my best friend during a group project in high school, though she did most of the organizing...
Do you often interrupt people or blurt things out before they’re finished?

Yeah, I do that a lot, actually. Like, especially when we're brainstorming for a project. I'll just blurt out my idea or, like, start adding stuff to their Figma board before they're even done explaining what they're thinking. And I can always tell afterward that I came off as super pushy, which I hate, because I'm just really excited about the idea, you know? Figma is so great for that, though. Have you ever used it? It's this collaborative design tool, and it's basically changed my life. Before that, I was trying to do everything in Illustrator, and sharing files back and forth was just a nightmare. My computer kept crashing because the files were so huge. I actually need to get a new laptop soon, but I've been putting off researching which one to get because there are just too many options. I kind of want a Mac, but they're so expensive... wait, what were we talking about? Oh, right, interrupting. Yeah, I definitely do that.
